fetch.emptyListNoHwid: The subscription returned an empty list. Some panels serve servers only to a device that sends its ID (HWID): turn on “Send HWID” for this subscription
fetch.hwidRequired: The provider serves this subscription only to devices that send their ID (HWID)
fetch.deviceLimit: Every device slot of this subscription is taken: the provider can free one
fetch.placeholder: The provider sent notices instead of servers
fetch.said: The provider answered: “{{said}}”. The answer has no servers

body.encrypted: The provider sends this list only encrypted, for its own app. Such lists are not read here: the provider can give a plain link

headers.invalid: Line {{line}}: a header must look like “Name: value” (ASCII, one line)
headers.reserved: The connection sets the {{name}} header itself; it cannot be replaced

group.manualNoRequest: The manual group makes no requests to a provider

hidden.refused: The provider hid the server settings of this subscription: the key cannot be shown, copied or exported
